name: Ducks
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was obtainable from a bundle that included the paint, 77 containers, 77 ultra containers, and 77 gold boxes. The bundle was at a 45% discount for 16 900 tankoins and it was available for 3 days from May 21st-24th 2021.
The paint was added to ultra containers on May 28th, 2021.
It's unclear whether this paint depicts rubber ducks (the bath toys) or rubber ducks (the mutant waterfowl)
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
